name: A'Jatt
storyline:
Rione Luzzatti. Naples.

In recent years, some children have mysteriously disappeared in that very neighborhood—vanishing right before their mothers’ eyes, without anyone noticing a thing. Your mother has asked you to take care of the house for a day. In the house there is also a cat, unusually large and with strange behaviors. Will you simply do what you’ve been asked, or will you try to uncover what’s really going on?
